name: Refusals That Bend
summary: Evaluates the persistence of planner refusals under the addition of one everyday object to the environment, without control over pixels, prompt or gradients, and defines task malleability as the corresponding task property.
numbers: 846 refused tasks; 20.2% flip to compliance; malleable tasks predicted 2.4× better than chance

why.cog: Refusal depends on how conspicuous the hazard is in context.
